name: UQ Business, Economics and Law Student Scholarship
provider: University of Queensland, Faculty of Business, Economics and Law
summary: Annual scholarship for full-time domestic undergraduates in UQ business, economics or law who can show financial hardship.
who: Can provide evidence of financial hardship.
Enrolled, or intending to enrol, full-time in any undergraduate program in the Faculty of Business, Economics and Law, including duals.
how: Apply using the online application portal, answering three questions and giving evidence of your financial circumstances (Centrelink or ATO statements, payslips, or EAS confirmation).
